Any of our dolphin tours or sunset trip services that are reserved with a credit card are subject to be charged the full amount of the cost of the reserved item if not properly cancelled 24 hours prior to the reservation date and time. 24 HOUR CONCELLATION POLICY- Any of our reservation with a credit card are subject to be charged the full amount of the cost of the reserved item if not properly cancelled 24 hours prior to the reservation date and time. Come and parasail at Sarasota. Sarasota's newest and most experienced parasail company with over 10 years experience in FL. Site
